content: You will be given an argumentation and asked about to find the relation from relation types: sup (support), exa (support by example), add (additional source), reb (rebutting attack), und (undercutting attack), joint (joining relation) between two selected argument components from it.

The bachelor thesis reflects both the content and the methods of the topics covered during a degree programme. But one can make occasional mistakes in the thesis. If this carries more weight, many good individual assignments done during the course of study may be obscured. A good grade for the thesis also significantly depends on the supervision of a dedicated teacher. Due to the many random factors the bachelor thesis should not play a bigger role.
What is the relation between "If this carries more weight, many good individual assignments done during the course of study may be obscured." and "Due to the many random factors the bachelor thesis should not play a bigger role." from the above essay? Choose from following options  1. reb
2. und
3. joint
4. exa
5. sup
6. no relation
